name: shell-ast
description: Full AST exposure for shell scripts via mvdan/sh compiled to WASM

scripts.build:wasm: mkdir -p dist && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -o dist/shell-ast.wasm ./processor
scripts.build:ts: bun build src/index.ts src/semantic.ts --outdir dist --target node && tsc --declaration --emitDeclarationOnly --outDir dist && cp src/wasm_exec.js dist/wasm_exec.js
scripts.build: bun run build:wasm && bun run build:ts
